formats.purpose: Timed CPU attribution on the existing single physical SSD; compare V7/V8 under identical whole-process P-core affinity. Diagnostic only, not an SSD performance ranking.
formats.placement: taskset 0-15 on benchmark; inherited by application, WAL and engine threads. Verify zero E-core userspace samples. No global scheduler or device changes.
formats.profiling: Preserved phase scopes sample 1/64 calls per thread with CPU and wall clocks; inclusive scopes are not summed with children. perf cpu-clock:u 499Hz, DWARF4096, sample-cpu, enabled only during timed writes via existing control FIFOs. perf stream remains in memfd until workload completion.
formats.storage_flag: p99_ms >10 OR mean fdatasync_ms >1; preserve every diagnostic and label flags. Diagnostics do not enter best-score tables even when eligible.
formats.comparison: Inspect CPU hotspots repeated across reversed format order, not just relative percentages. Stalls change concurrency and CPU work, so phase differences do not by themselves prove a source-level regression.

allocator.purpose: Reversible V8 allocator CPU diagnostic: baseline glibc versus installed mimalloc C overrides, including aligned buffers. perf collector does not inherit the override. Not a production allocator adoption or qualified SSD gain.
allocator.memory_metric: wait4 ru_maxrss for the perf command tree: maximum individual process RSS, not the sum or a timed-only peak. Includes the benchmark and profiler.
allocator.override: LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/libmimalloc.so.2 on the benchmark child only; no package install or host allocator setting changes
